parameters.physical_question: Is the completed worn look in frame and readable, and which whole-look limits apply?

parameters.observation_state_model: OBSERVED · NOT_VISIBLE · UNKNOWN (no ABSENT: the look always has the phenomenon or it is unreadable)
parameters.source_route: DIRECT LOOK

parameters.implementation_note: packet.look_frame (state + limits)
parameters.criticality_rationale: fail-closed control: a wrong OBSERVED frame turns hidden evidence into absent evidence on every axis
